Mr. B, a 47-year-old man, 6 ft 2 in tall and weighing 200 lb, is admitted to 
the hospital with chest pain. Three days after admission, at patient care 
rounds, it is discovered that Mr. B has gained 30 pounds over the last 
2 years. Review of the medical record reveals the following laboratory 
data: LDL: 240 (desirable 130), HDL 30 (desirable .50), triglyceride 
350 (desirable ,200). Blood pressure is 120/85. Current medications: 
multivitamin/mineral daily. Cardiac catheterization is scheduled for tomorrow. 
Diet history reveals frequent consumption of high fat foods.
